'''Three Corners''' is a crossroads just inside [[Redridge Mountains]] that is patrolled by a lone [[Stormwind]] guard, [[Guard Parker]]. The crossroads splits three ways and leads to the "Three Shires". It runs west into [[Elwynn Forest]] to [[Goldshire]], east to [[Lakeshire]], and south into [[Duskwood]] to [[Darkshire]].
